title: Where an e-mail template comes from
caption: notification_templates (key, channel, locale) and the code defaults in ota/backend/src/notifications/templates. The editor sends If-Match whenever the page showed a version (the seeded row included). Code: settings/templates/actions.ts.

states.label: Default (code)
states.detail: No row for the key and locale or its language: the bundled `.hbs` files; "Never changed".

states.label: Inherited from <language>
states.detail: No row of the locale (e.g. `fr-CA`), the language's row (`fr`) serves it; "See the <language> template".

states.label: Default (own copy)
states.detail: Row seeded by provisioning from the code default: has a `version`, not customised.

states.label: Refused draft
states.detail: `422 TEMPLATE_INVALID` listed per part and line; nothing saved; `failed` staff action.
